## **Precio y paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      5 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 10 sept 2026 - 16 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Geraldine Rolo_, 16 sept 2026, 1/5: "I had subscribed to a trial period and I immediately canceled the subscription in the playstore to avoid deductions in the future. the app no longer appeared under my subscription list. i received a notification from my bank informing me that this app had deducted money from my account without my consent"
            2. _E D_, 16 sept 2026, 1/5: "this app charged me for subscription without giving any notice to give me time to cancel the free trial and know I cannot go to the billing terms in the app. because it says no internet connection eventhough I clearly have internet. this is clearly a scam."
            3. _David Thurlow_, 16 sept 2026, 1/5: "I gave this app a trial. It wasn't for me so I tried to cancel my subscription. That was nearly a year ago. I have been charged every quarter since. Have tried to remove my card details without success. Beware!!"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Errores y estabilidad** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Errores y estabilidad.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan errores y estabilidad.
      Ventana de reseñas: 23 may 2026 - 15 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Los usuarios mencionan crashes o inestabilidad. Trátalo como accionable solo si el volumen sube o sigue a una update; si no, suele ser ruido baseline.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _Bonolo Rambau_, 15 sept 2026, 1/5: "the app glitches, i can't even access my meal plan. I have been a member for less than an hour"
            2. _Jerick Órdenes_, 11 sept 2026, 1/5: "The app freezes on every start and sometimes crashes. It's very annoying for a paid app."
            3. _Sabina Kotiranta_, 23 may 2026, 1/5: "would be nice if it stops crashing.... Reinstalled it twice now."
<!--/ir-theme-->
